datasets.name: ds_hero_header
queryLines:
SELECT t.display_name, t.total_balance, t.modules_with_balance, t.signal_count,
       coalesce(size(split(t.open_episodes, '; ')), 0) AS open_episode_count
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.v_tp360_header t WHERE concat(t.display_name, ' (', t.tin_token, ')') = :taxpayer

datasets.name: ds_hero_signals
queryLines:
SELECT s.signal_id, s.severity, s.evidence
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.v_tp_signals s JOIN workspace.tp360_poc.tp_taxpayer t USING (tin_token)
WHERE concat(t.display_name, ' (', t.tin_token, ')') = :taxpayer
ORDER BY CASE s.severity WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, s.signal_id

datasets.name: ds_hero_modules
queryLines:
SELECT CAST(m.tax_period AS STRING) AS tax_period, m.assessed_balance AS balance,
       CAST(m.csed AS STRING) AS csed, CASE WHEN c.suspended_ind = 'Y' THEN 'Suspended' ELSE 'Running' END AS csed_status
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.tp_tax_module m JOIN workspace.tp360_poc.tp_taxpayer t USING (tin_token)
LEFT JOIN workspace.tp360_poc.tp_statutory_clock c ON c.module_id = m.module_id AND c.clock_type = 'CSED'
WHERE concat(t.display_name, ' (', t.tin_token, ')') = :taxpayer AND m.assessed_balance > 0
ORDER BY tax_period

datasets.name: ds_hero_episodes
queryLines:
SELECT e.episode_type, e.episode_subtype, e.status, CAST(e.opened_date AS STRING) AS opened
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.tp_compliance_episode e JOIN workspace.tp360_poc.tp_taxpayer t USING (tin_token)
WHERE concat(t.display_name, ' (', t.tin_token, ')') = :taxpayer AND e.closed_date IS NULL
ORDER BY e.opened_date

datasets.name: ds_hero_history
queryLines:
SELECT CAST(tax_period AS STRING) AS tax_period, program, outcome,
       CAST(closed_date AS STRING) AS closed, deficiency, issues
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.v_prior_audit_history t WHERE concat(t.display_name, ' (', t.tin_token, ')') = :taxpayer
ORDER BY tax_period

datasets.name: ds_hero_related
queryLines:
SELECT DISTINCT r.related_name, r.hops, r.path, r.via_name, r.related_signals
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.v_related_parties_named r JOIN workspace.tp360_poc.tp_taxpayer t ON t.tin_token = r.tin_token
WHERE concat(t.display_name, ' (', t.tin_token, ')') = :taxpayer AND r.related_signals IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: ds_taxpayer_list
queryLines:
SELECT concat(t.display_name, ' (', t.tin_token, ')') AS taxpayer
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.v_tp360_header t
WHERE t.entity_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND (t.signal_count > 0 OR t.total_balance > 0
       OR t.tin_token IN (SELECT tin_token FROM workspace.tp360_poc.tp_case_closure)
       OR t.tin_token IN (SELECT tin_token FROM workspace.tp360_poc.tp_compliance_episode WHERE closed_date IS NULL))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.case_group LIKE 'HERO%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, taxpayer

datasets.name: ds_rve_compare
queryLines:
SELECT t.display_name AS taxpayer, c.form, c.line, c.line_desc, c.as_filed, c.as_adjusted, c.delta, c.data_origin
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.v_return_compare c JOIN workspace.tp360_poc.tp_taxpayer t USING (tin_token)
WHERE c.tax_period = 202412 AND c.delta <> 0 AND t.case_group IN ('HERO_A', 'HERO_B')
ORDER BY taxpayer, CASE WHEN c.form = '1040' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, c.form, c.line

datasets.name: ds_rve_origin
datasets.displayName: Where return data came from — 2024 heroes
queryLines:
SELECT concat(t.display_name, ' · ', o.version_type) AS snapshot, o.data_origin, o.line_count
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.v_rve_data_origin o JOIN workspace.tp360_poc.tp_taxpayer t USING (tin_token)
WHERE o.tax_period = 202412 AND t.case_group IN ('HERO_A', 'HERO_B')
ORDER BY snapshot, o.data_origin

datasets.name: ds_rve_findings
queryLines:
SELECT t.display_name AS taxpayer, f.branch,
       CASE f.branch WHEN 'A' THEN 'Resolved from data' WHEN 'B' THEN 'Not a taxpayer issue' ELSE 'Needs the taxpayer (IDR)' END AS branch_meaning,
       f.item, f.irp_amount, f.return_ref, f.return_amount, f.root_cause, f.note
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.tp_rri_finding f JOIN workspace.tp360_poc.tp_taxpayer t USING (tin_token)
WHERE f.tax_period = 202412 AND t.case_group IN ('HERO_A', 'HERO_B')
ORDER BY taxpayer, f.branch, f.finding_id

datasets.name: ds_rve_exams
queryLines:
SELECT t.display_name AS taxpayer, r.deficiency, r.taxable_income_change, r.episode_status
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.v_exam_results r JOIN workspace.tp360_poc.tp_taxpayer t USING (tin_token)
WHERE r.tax_period = 202412 ORDER BY r.deficiency DESC

datasets.name: ds_sig_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT count(DISTINCT tin_token) AS taxpayers_with_signals,
       count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN severity = 'HIGH' THEN tin_token END) AS taxpayers_with_high,
       count(*) AS signal_rows
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.v_tp_signals

datasets.name: ds_sig_by_rule
queryLines:
SELECT signal_id, count(DISTINCT tin_token) AS taxpayers
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.v_tp_signals GROUP BY signal_id ORDER BY taxpayers DESC

datasets.name: ds_sig_top
queryLines:
SELECT display_name, tin_token, entity_type, total_balance, signal_count, signals, open_episodes
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.v_tp360_header WHERE signal_count > 0
ORDER BY signal_count DESC, total_balance DESC LIMIT 25

datasets.name: ds_cc_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT count(*) AS closed_cases, sum(deficiency) AS total_deficiency,
       round(100.0 * count_if(outcome = 'NO_CHANGE') / count(*), 1) AS no_change_pct,
       round(sum(deficiency) / sum(total_hours), 0) AS deficiency_per_hour
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.v_case_results

datasets.name: ds_cc_lines
queryLines:
SELECT concat(form, ' ', line, ' — ', line_desc) AS return_line, adjustments, cases, avg_abs_adjustment
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.v_line_adjustment_frequency ORDER BY adjustments DESC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_cc_detection
queryLines:
SELECT detection_source, issues, adjusted, adjusted_pct, total_abs_sustained
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.v_detection_mix ORDER BY adjusted DESC

datasets.name: ds_cc_issues
queryLines:
SELECT issue_code, issue_name, times_raised, adjusted, conceded, no_change, no_change_pct,
       avg_pct_sustained_of_proposed, avg_hours, sustained_per_hour
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.v_issue_outcomes WHERE times_raised >= 10 ORDER BY times_raised DESC

datasets.name: ds_cc_program
queryLines:
SELECT program, outcome, count(*) AS cases, round(avg(deficiency), 0) AS avg_deficiency,
       round(avg(total_hours), 1) AS avg_hours, round(sum(deficiency) / sum(total_hours), 0) AS deficiency_per_hour
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.v_case_results GROUP BY program, outcome ORDER BY program, cases DESC

datasets.name: ds_cc_rootcause
queryLines:
SELECT root_cause, sum(findings) AS findings
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.v_variance_root_causes GROUP BY root_cause ORDER BY findings DESC

datasets.name: ds_cc_trace
queryLines:
SELECT issue_code, issue_name, role, source_line, rollup_path
FROM workspace.tp360_poc.v_issue_to_1040_trace ORDER BY issue_code, role DESC
